description: A picture of the part of the page a field was read from, as the app shows it: each reading's place boxed (green; red when its quote wasn't found word for word); for a cell of a table, the rest of its row (blue, dashed) and the column headers. For a disputed field, to show the person what the page says. For a file of several documents, use that document's job_id. Needs the job's document: not after the account's "delete right after reading" (then the quote and page in the result are what there is). PDF, PNG, JPG and HEIC.

field.description: The field's path, as in the result: named_insured.name, vehicles[1].vin.

target.description: For a workflow with several targets: which target's field.

name: get_evidence
title: Where a value was read
